name: Mikanagi Himari
source: Before she was old enough to know anything, she lost both her parents and her hometown. Ever since she has been living in Tokyo with her mother's friend. One day she receives an invitation from her hometown, the gears of fate begin to spin out of control as she steps into the otherworldly village
